lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: How did your DNA get in the truck?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: It ain't.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: And how do you know that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Cuz I never went in it.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Do he drives the truck down there himself? I don't think so. Brendan, did you help him take the truck down there. If you did, so what.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I didn't.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Where were you when he did that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I was at home.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: You went home, home, to your house?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: mm huh.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Who was home?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: My mom.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: See, I can't believe that now. I'm sorry. Your mom wasn't home. Your mom was at Scott's.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Brendan, d-do you want us to walk out of here? Is that what you want? Then quit lying to us.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: First version you say you went down and ended up yet with Steven with the RAV4. You saw some things down there. You told us about those things. Where'd you come up with that? You told us that Steve took the license plates off the vehicle. You told us that Steven went under the hood of the vehicle. What did you just grab that out of the air? How do you know those things?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Just guessing.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Your mom's not home. Why did you just lie about that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: Well he didn't, didn't take the jeep down right away.
